page.overview:
Who is Jek Bannon?

Jek Bannon was a male Human who worked for the Five Brothers Resort and Casino on the space station known as Centerpoint Station during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire. Whilst working for the casino, he was sent to take promotional pictures of the Conical Six mountain but passed out due to heat exhaustion during the climb. He was found and rescued by a group of spacers also hired to perform work for the casino on the mountain.

During the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire, the Human boy Jek Bannon worked for the Five Brothers Resort and Casino, an establishment on the Centerpoint space station. At the age of fifteen he worked under the Twi'lek Sura as part of the Five Brothers' operations on Conical Six, one of the the space stations' Southern Conical Mountains. Shortly after Five Brothers' obtained the rights to exclusive use of the mountain, Sura sent Bannon up the mountain to capture a number of holographic images for commercial use by the casino. The boy brought a bag of equipment with him, but after encountering the extreme heat generated by Glowpoint, an artificial sun near the mountain, he passed out in a cave while trying to put on a rebreather.

A group of spacers hired by the casino to clear out a vynock infestation on the mountain later found Bannon, and after the group were attacked by several vynocks, he awoke and thanked them before contacting Sura to arrange pick up. The group, one of whom collected Bannon's bag, then brought the boy with them to the mountains summit where an airspeeder collected them all. Thankful to see him safe Sura paid the spacers an extra 300 credits for his rescue and the return of the equipment.

When found by spacers he was extremely thankful, as was Sura who had worried for the young boy when he didn't return.
